usage: custodian [-h] {run,schema,report,logs,metrics,version,validate} ...

Cloud Custodian - Cloud fleet management

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit

commands:
  {run,schema,report,logs,metrics,version,validate}
    run                 Execute the policies in a config file
    schema              Interactive cli docs for policy authors
    report              Tabular report on policy matched resources
    version             Display installed version of custodian
    validate            Validate config files against the json schema

usage: custodian run [-h] [-r REGION] [--profile PROFILE]
                     [--assume ASSUME_ROLE] [--external-id EXTERNAL_ID]
                     [-p POLICY_FILTERS] [-t RESOURCE_TYPES] [-v] [-q]
                     [-l LOG_GROUP] -s OUTPUT_DIR [-f CACHE]
                     [--cache-period CACHE_PERIOD]
                     [--session-policy SESSION_POLICY] [-d]
                     [--skip-validation] [-m [PROVIDER]] [--trace [TRACER]]
                     [configs ...]

Execute the policies in a config file.

Multiple regions can be passed in, as can the symbolic region 'all'. 

When running across multiple regions, policies targeting resources in 
regions where they do not exist will not be run. The output directory 
when passing multiple regions is suffixed with the region. Resources 
with global endpoints are run just once and are suffixed with the first 
region passed in or us-east-1 if running against 'all' regions.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  -l LOG_GROUP, --log-group LOG_GROUP
                        Location to send policy logs (Ex: AWS CloudWatch Log
                        Group)
  -s OUTPUT_DIR, --output-dir OUTPUT_DIR
                        [REQUIRED] Directory or S3 URL For policy output
  -f CACHE, --cache CACHE
                        Cache file (default ~/.cache/cloud-custodian.cache)
  --cache-period CACHE_PERIOD
                        Cache validity in minutes (default 15)
  --session-policy SESSION_POLICY
                        [OPTIONAL] AWS IAM Policy Document to be used as a
                        session policy
  -d, --dryrun, --dry-run
                        Don't execute actions but filter resources
  --skip-validation     Skips validation of policies (assumes you've run the
                        validate command separately).
  -m [PROVIDER], --metrics-enabled [PROVIDER]
                        Emit metrics to provider metrics. Specify 'aws',
                        'gcp', or 'azure'. For more details on aws metrics
                        options, see:
                        https://cloudcustodian.io/docs/aws/usage.html#metrics
  --trace [TRACER]      Tracing integration

provider:
  AWS account information, defaults per the aws cli

  -r REGION, --region REGION
                        AWS Region to target. Can be used multiple times
  --profile PROFILE     Account Config File Profile to utilize
                        (AWS/TencentCloud)
  --assume ASSUME_ROLE  Role or Service Account to assume
  --external-id EXTERNAL_ID
                        External Id to provide when assuming a role

config:
  Policy config file(s) and policy selectors

  configs               Policy configuration file(s) or directory
  -p POLICY_FILTERS, --policies POLICY_FILTERS
                        Only use named/matched policies
  -t RESOURCE_TYPES, --resource RESOURCE_TYPES
                        Only use policies with the given resource type

output:
  Output control

  -v, --verbose         Verbose logging
  -q, --quiet           Less logging (repeatable, -qqq for no output)

usage: custodian schema [-h] [--summary] [--json] [--outline] [-v] [selector]

Browse the available vocabularies (resources, filters, modes, and actions) for
policy construction. The selector is specified with RESOURCE[.CATEGORY[.ITEM]]
examples: s3, ebs.actions, or ec2.filters.instance-age

positional arguments:
  selector

options:
  -h, --help     show this help message and exit
  --summary      Summarize counts of available resources, actions and filters
  --json         Export custodian's jsonschema
  --outline      Print outline of all resources and their actions and filters
  -v, --verbose  Verbose logging

                        [-p POLICY_FILTERS] [-t RESOURCE_TYPES] [-v] -s

                        [--days DAYS] [--raw RAW] [--field HEADER=FIELD]
                        [--no-default-fields]
                        [--format {csv,grid,simple,json}] [--all-findings]
                        [configs ...]

Report of resources that a policy matched/ran on. The default output format is
csv, but other formats are available.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  -s OUTPUT_DIR, --output-dir OUTPUT_DIR

                        [OPTIONAL] AWS IAM Policy Document to be used as a

  --days DAYS           Number of days of history to consider

  --field HEADER=FIELD  Repeatable. JMESPath of field to include in the output

usage: custodian [-h] {run,schema,report,logs,metrics,version,validate} ...

--add-child-tenancies.help: Add the child tenancies to the c7n-org configuration file

--after.help: Only stream commits after given date

--all-findings.help: Outputs all findings per resource. Defaults to a single finding per resource.

--assume.help: Role or Service Account to assume

--before.help: Only stream commits before given date

--cert-key.help: Path to the certificate's private key

--check.help: only show pull requests that are still open

--creator-tag.help: Tag to utilize for resource creator

--err-invalid.help: Fail/stop if there are errors present in the HCL

--external-id.help: External Id to provide when assuming a role

--field.help: Repeatable. JMESPath of field to include in the output OR for a tag use prefix `tag:`. Special case fields `region` and`policy` are available

--filters.help: filter policies or resources as k=v pairs with globbing

--format.help: Format to output data in (default: %(default)s). Options include simple, grid, csv, json

--generate.help: Generate a k8s manifest for ValidatingWebhookConfiguration

--group.help: log group to export to s3.

--help.help: show this help message and exit

--ignore.help: list of accounts that won't be added to the config file

--incomplete.help: filter to buckets not scanned fully

--input.help: file with pull request details (produced by download)

--max-repo.help: Maximum number of repositories to process

--metrics.help: The resource name or instrumentation key for uploading metrics

--month.help: Only process trail events for the given month

--not-account.help: exclude the given accounts from scan

--on-exception.help: warn or deny on policy exceptions

--ou.help: Only export the given subtrees of an organization

--outline.help: Print outline of all resources and their actions and filters

--output-dir.help: [REQUIRED] Directory or S3 URL For policy output

--output-query.help: Use a jmespath expression to filter json output

--per-account.help: Validate per account with variable expansion

--plain.help: Expect MESSAGE_FILE to be a plain string, rather than the base64-encoded, gzipped SQS message format

--policy-name.help: Policy name if multiple policies to mimic MESSAGE_FILE. Defaults to the first.

--policy-pattern.help: Only look at policy files matching the giving glob pattern (including dir)

--policy-regex.help: The policy must match the regex

--policy-uri.help: The URI to the Azure storage container that holds the policies

--prefix.help: name of the tag to filter with using get_object_tagging API.

--present.help: Target policies present in config files for removal instead of skipping them.

--profile.help: Account Config File Profile to utilize (AWS/TencentCloud)

--query-id.help: Process results of a previous Athena query

--queue-name.help: The name of the event queue to create

--raw.help: Store raw json of collected records to given file path

--region.help: AWS Region to target.  Can be used multiple times

--regions.help: If specified, set regions per account in config

--registry.help: Registries for image repo on tag and push

--resource.help: Only use policies with the given resource type

--resource-map.help: Resource map of events and id selectors

--role.help: sts role to assume for log group access

--scan.help: scan the image for cve with trivy

--session-policy.help: [OPTIONAL] AWS IAM Policy Document to be used as a session policy

--size.help: filter to buckets with at least size

--skip-validation.help: Skips validation of policies (assumes you've run the validate command separately).

--sse-kms-key-id.help: Key id for SSE-KMS encrypted objects

--state.help: File to store the generated config (default stdout)

--storage-id.help: The resource id of the storage account to create the event queue in

--stream-uri.help: Destination stream for logical changes (supports stdout/jsonline/kinesis/sqs/sqlalchemy)

--strict.help: Any deprecations will cause a non-zero exit code

--summary.help: Summarize counts of available resources, actions and filters

--test.help: Run lightweight functional tests with image
